880-5478-8338.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-8338.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2981-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2981-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2921-4186-6566--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2122-3698-6972.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Mindless Automaton enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

3175-4775-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

240-1322-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2292-3991-5987.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-2829-7189.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability
Repeat.

775-1409-6753.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3967-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
3967-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1369-1902-7086.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
1369-1902-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Wirewood Channeler's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Wirewood Channeler's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

1978-2392-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Repeat.

883-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2459-2511-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

539-5256-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4484-6440-6798.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4484-6440-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

2511-3055-3175.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

342-1284-1729-3908-4385.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Shelob.
Shelob does not have summoning sickness.
342-1284-1729-3908-4385.description:
Activate Shelob by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Sliver Queen.
Sliver Queen dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch, triggering Shelob, creating a token copy of Sliver Queen that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Sliver Queen token by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat step 3.

618-4613-4620.notablePrerequisites: Captain of the Mists has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-4613-4620.description:
Activate Captain of the Mists using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Captain of the Mists token enters the battlefield, each other Captain of the Mists you cotnrol triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary Human you control.

896-5016-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate General's Regalia by paying {3}, choosing to redirect the next damage Volcano Hellion does to you to Spitemare instead.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's ability, dealing an arbirarily large amount of damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

3086-3175-4598-4605.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Lagrella.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it and Preston triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Lagrella that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Put the nontoken Lagrella into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Lagrella is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
Sun Titan, Lagrella and Preston each trigger.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sun Titan that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sun Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choosing to return nothing to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger from step 8, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1636-4300-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic land.
654-1636-4300-4913.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the basic land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
When the Illusion enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion, causing you to draw a card and put the basic land from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
When the land enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

814-2751-4050-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-2751-4050-4853.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Soldiers, adding {2}.
When the Soldiers die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice, untapping Strionic Resonator and any other artifact you control.
Repeat from step 2.

96-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Thopter Mechanic, adding {C}{C}.
Thopter Mechanic dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Thopter Mechanic trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Thopter Mechanic from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

132-198-1978.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
132-198-1978.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

101-2665-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
101-2665-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the token Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
